q: A system (X,f) is equicontinuous if the family of iterates {fⁿ} is equicontinuous. Equicontinuous minimal systems are called:
opts: Isometric (isomorphic to a rotation on a compact group)
exp: By the Ellis-Auslander theorem, equicontinuous minimal systems are isomorphic (as dynamical systems) to rotations on compact abelian groups. They have purely discrete spectrum — the opposite of chaos.
